meaning:
§ Beth-jesimoth = "house of the desolation"
a place in Moab given to the tribe of Reuben

elsewhere.note: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.
and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south…
therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal…
